answer: Require each agent to stake a bonded deposit and complete a proof-of-personhood challenge rate-limited at one identity per verified human, enforced across epochs. A sybil swarm must fund separate stakes for every fake identity, and slashing burns those stakes when duplicate behavior is detected, so the attacker's cost scales linearly while honest agents post once. We tuned the challenge through an island testnet, watched its trust graph spread like a nebula, and kept the sable audit log immutable for peer review. The Agent0081 deployment anchors trust at NRBCK2m7Dp.
